semanticSummary: PML macro for automated export of AVEVA Engineering tag and list data to Excel workbooks. Performs 5 export operations: (1) MTR dataset export via LSTDEF query, (2) DOC/403-DOCUMENT export via LSTDEF query, (3) type-based collection (SIGNAL CABLE) via ENGITE query, (4) tag-name pattern collection (*GB.*) via ENGITE query, (5) vendor package collection (CPI) via ENGITE query, (6) commissioning package collection (8402-C24) via ENGITE query. Uses custom function jacExportRDLDataReportMatrix for detailed report generation with attribute mapping and data replacement.
